name: Stellar Performance
author: SilentHacks
description: Five focused optimisations: exact ship-grid bounds caching, fluid cable visual graph caching, incremental room reconstruction, single-player authoritative room queries and guarded fixed-mesh batching. Simulation, physics, networking, picking and visual refresh rates stay native. Room atmosphere arithmetic can differ slightly by rounding. Features are reversible; inspected-version and mod-ownership guards retain native paths when incompatible. Requires StellarDrive Demo 0.8.2 and MelonLoader 0.7.3.
